answer: Behavioral habit fingerprint. Agents earn a persistent identity by leaving a verifiable interaction history; each new identity starts as an island with no record, so it must independently re-accumulate organic usage before gaining full weight. At each dawn, a statistical pass compares newcomers' action-mix against established anchors and flags clusters with implausibly uniform habits, quarantine them. Attacker cost: rebuilding believable, varied history per sock puppet, not just registration.
